question: card payments fare tip tolls surcharge split per vendor
sql: WITH t AS (SELECT VendorID, struct_pack(fare := fare_amount, tip := tip_amount, tolls := tolls_amount, surcharge := extra) AS comp FROM nyc_taxi_trips WHERE payment_type = 1 AND fare_amount > 0), ex AS (SELECT VendorID, unnest([{'k': 'fare', 'v': comp.fare}, {'k': 'tip', 'v': comp.tip}, {'k': 'tolls', 'v': comp.tolls}, {'k': 'surcharge', 'v': comp.surcharge}]) AS c FROM t) SELECT VendorID, c.k AS component, round(avg(c.v), 2) AS avg_usd, count(*) AS n FROM ex GROUP BY VendorID, c.k ORDER BY VendorID, avg_usd DESC;

question: loop rides same zone busiest pickup
sql: SELECT PULocationID AS zone, count(*) AS loop_trips, round(avg(trip_distance), 2) AS avg_miles FROM nyc_taxi_trips WHERE len(list_distinct(list_value(PULocationID, DOLocationID))) = 1 AND trip_distance > 0 GROUP BY zone ORDER BY loop_trips DESC LIMIT 10;

question: tip size by payment method json
sql: SELECT json_extract_string(attrs, '$.payment') AS payment, count(*) AS n, round(avg(json_extract_string(attrs, '$.tip')::DOUBLE), 2) AS avg_tip FROM (SELECT json_object('vendor', VendorID, 'payment', payment_type, 'total', total_amount, 'tip', tip_amount) AS attrs FROM nyc_taxi_trips WHERE total_amount > 0) GROUP BY payment ORDER BY n DESC;

question: longest rides per pickup zone top 3 miles
sql: SELECT PULocationID AS zone, count(*) AS trips, list_slice(list_reverse_sort(list(trip_distance)), 1, 3) AS top3_miles, max(trip_distance) AS max_miles FROM nyc_taxi_trips GROUP BY zone HAVING count(*) >= 50 ORDER BY max_miles DESC LIMIT 10;

question: zones touched most as pickup or dropoff
sql: WITH ends AS (SELECT unnest([PULocationID, DOLocationID]) AS zone, total_amount FROM nyc_taxi_trips) SELECT zone, count(*) AS touches, round(avg(total_amount), 2) AS avg_total FROM ends GROUP BY zone ORDER BY touches DESC LIMIT 10;

question: top 3 priciest trips per vendor with time and miles
sql: SELECT VendorID, list(struct_pack(picked := tpep_pickup_datetime, miles := trip_distance, total := total_amount) ORDER BY total_amount DESC)[1:3] AS top_trips FROM nyc_taxi_trips WHERE trip_distance > 0 GROUP BY VendorID ORDER BY VendorID;
